run_ml_train_co2r: run ML model training on CO2R experimental data with random forest and leave-one-out cross validation
run_ml_train_her: run ML model training on HER voltage prediction data using linear regression and leave-one-component-out cross validation
run_ml_train_with_processed_df: run ML training from a preprocessed CSV dataframe with specified energy aggregation method and output directory
run_ml_train_with_el_features: run ML training with Matminer elemental features added to adsorption energy descriptors for improved predictions
run_ml_train_xrd_filtered: run ML training filtered on XRD matched samples only with specified max RWP and minimum Q score thresholds
